rules: Every generated runnable playbook must have a revision-explicit verification_profile.json before it can claim LOCALLY_VERIFIED.
The profile is the executable source of truth for which algorithmic checks run in FAST, PRE_EDITOR, POST_EDITOR and RELEASE phases.
The model may select applicable invariants and profile entries, but must not substitute remembered/manual command lists for the profile.
Required checks fail closed. Missing runner, missing evidence, dependency failure, timeout or nonzero deterministic result blocks the phase.
Readiness is derived from machine-readable profile execution evidence, not from prose claims.
External editor/live-run/dry-check results enter through explicit external_evidence checks and are analyzed after import.
Custom Python verification is allowed only from a package-local script path declared in the profile.
Verification result must state which invariants each check covers and which required invariants remain unverified.
